provider_note: The Claude adapter is blocked by missing mandatory isolation flags. Use the native agent fallback; do not weaken the runner requirements.

manifests.scope: Loopback HTTP/WebSocket Rig service, fake-backed tests, service docs, pyproject only; no uv.lock.
Independent schedule clock, task/proposal telemetry, scoreboard producers and tests/docs; never depend on unreleased T12b.
Narrow Rig client/contract authentication update; endpoint paths and payloads stay unchanged.
Mirror watch_answers into profile.yaml; onboarding never asks or writes access_level; preserve admin and default new profiles to member.

integration_rules: One writer per declared file; coordinator owns integration, shared __init__.py and root CHANGELOG edits.

T12b uses service token name rig.service_token in keyring service OASIS (SecretStore username/account rig.service_token), HTTP Authorization Bearer, and WebSocket protocols [bearer, token]; no URL token.
Use only fake credentials such as sk-FAKE-0000 in tests; never generate or read real updater keys.
T12b uses injectable real-adapter seams and local fake backends in tests; do not replace T07/T08/T11 with a fake production service.
T15 must remain independently releasable and must not import or depend on T12b.
